svg.title: Parking & seating
svg.desc: Separate courtyard bay 3.6 by 5 metres and bench-end clear space 0.9 metres wide, with an illustrative 1.5 metre depth. A reference car and manual wheelchair user are shown side by side in the bay. Source claims: arrival. Bench-end depth 1.5 m, decorative tiles and bench dimensions are illustration assumptions. The two vignettes are independent. The car body is 5 × 1.8 m; the adjacent manual chair/user is an assumed .72 × 1.20 m, 1.35 m high. This placement does not validate door opening or transfer/lift clearance.
